$description: Multi-disorder rescue configuration with 4 primary targets (ASD, MDD, SCZ, SubstanceAbuse) and 8 comparator disorders (Bipolar, Anxiety, PTSD, OCD, ADHD, IntellectualDisability, EatingDisorders, Neurocognitive). All 12 disorders receive identical rescue treatment (paradigm-LLM-scoring + DisGeNET fetch + tier classification) so cross-disorder contrasts are evidence-symmetric. Only the 4 primaries are benchmarked with Stage 1-7; the 8 comparators populate per-(target, contrast) negative pools at the same tier as the target's positive set.

Tier_1_mendelian_confirmed.label: Mendelian-confirmed
Tier_1_mendelian_confirmed.description: Two independent human Mendelian-curation pipelines agree. Headline tier.

Tier_2_common_variant_permissive.label: common-variant-permissive
Tier_2_common_variant_permissive.description: Tier 1b plus GWAS-only evidence. Sensitivity layer.

disorders.name: ASD
disorders.label: autism_spectrum_disorder
disorders.disease_terms_regex: autism|autistic|asperger|pervasive developmental|kanner

2.rationale: Cat 2: 2 de novo LGD OR uniquely-GWAS-with-functional. De novo path dominates.

3.rationale: Cat 3: 1 de novo LGD OR unreplicated assoc OR rare inherited.

S.rationale: Plain S: syndromic without independent ASD evidence. Flagged separately.

sfari.note: v1: all categories treated uniformly as Mendelian-confirmed. Per-category mapping is task #93.

disorders.notes: ASD has the most curated gene resources. Expect Tier 1 n in the high hundreds.

disorders.name: MDD
disorders.label: major_depressive_disorder
disorders.disease_terms_regex: depression|depressive|melancholic|dysthymic|disruptive mood dysregulation|premenstrual dysphoric|seasonal affective|postpartum depress|atypical depress|major depressive
disorders.notes: Highly polygenic; Tier 1 small, Tier 1b/Tier 2 larger via GWAS.

disease_terms_regex_2026_05_24.after: depression|depressive|melancholic|dysthymic|disruptive mood dysregulation|premenstrual dysphoric|seasonal affective|postpartum depress|atypical depress|major depressive

rescue_build.source_schema: v3_t1d binary masks via build_rescuepools_from_v3t1d.py (PM flag 6). rescue_line_output/MDD_per_genotype_tiers_v2.tsv v1 files are STALE, not consumed.
rescue_build.etiology_route: T1g-primary (PGC-MDD 2025 / Als 2023; 243-244 GWS loci; h2~0.084). MDD is a no-T1d-source disorder by design (PM flag 2).

l2g_status.policy: OpenTargets L2G is not accessible for non-SCZ disorders from this environment. Per Knowledge-Dump F.3, T1g headline uses MAGMA-Bonferroni INTERSECT MHC-excluded INTERSECT FUMA proximity-window as the documented operational substitute. Locked cross-disorder caveat, NOT a spec violation (PM flag 1). Uniform across all 10 non-SCZ disorders. SCZ is the only L2G-intersected headline (Trubetskoy 2022 Supp Table 11 surrogate).
l2g_status.methods_sentence: For non-SCZ disorders, OpenTargets L2G data is not accessible from our environment; T1g headline uses MAGMA-Bonferroni ∩ MHC-excluded ∩ FUMA proximity window as the documented operational substitute.

preflight_asd_contamination.check1_taxonomy_mdd_keyed_pathA: PASS (180 strict / 9 domains; 0 tier-5; 0 anti-direction strict in unidir-deficit)
preflight_asd_contamination.check3_gene_sources_mdd_derived: PASS (sources MDD-derived & ASD/SCZ-clean; T1g uses documented F.3 fallback, l2g_layer_applied=false)
preflight_asd_contamination.check5_cross_disorder_comparator_doc: DOC (A5-class comparators must use separate per-disorder taxonomy paths)
preflight_asd_contamination.check6_spotcheck: PASS-adapted (T1g positives 8/8 trace to MDD gene source; no ASD)

T1d_sensitivity.reason: No MDD/depression DNV cohort exists (publishedDeNovos has none; denovo-db UW server proxy-blocked). MDD is T1g-only by design; empty stub NOT promoted to T1d-strict.

T1g_headline.note: v3 T1c_DGM uses T0_DGM=6 (-> 980); Stage-5 base uses MDD_primary=8 (-> 982). Same set bar T0-definition.

T1c_headline.definition: T1g_headline UNION T1d_sensitivity; T1d empty => T1c == T1g

depth_mpclass.interpretation: T1g additions collapse to the broad_other floor on behavioral content (0.122 vs floor 0.077); they do NOT enrich for behavioral terms (delta_behav 0.809 > delta_depth 0.520). Empirical prior: the GWAS route alone is unlikely to lift A2 above Phenodigm 0.77 -- reinforces MDD as the negative boundary case.

tier0_baseline_for_downstream.A2_paired_auroc: 0.65 pipeline vs 0.77 Phenodigm (pipeline does NOT beat Phenodigm)
tier0_baseline_for_downstream.rescue_mandate: lift A2 above 0.77 AND make B1 nontrivial via rescue-tier positive pool

disorders.name: SCZ
disorders.label: schizophrenia_spectrum
disorders.disease_terms_regex: schizophren|schizoaffective|schizophreniform|brief psychotic|delusional disorder|psychotic disorder|schizotypal|psychosis|hallucinatory
disorders.notes: Mostly GWAS architecture with rare-variant CNVs (NRXN1, SETD1A, 22q11.2).

disorders.name: SubstanceAbuse
disorders.label: substance_use_disorder
disorders.disease_terms_regex: substance|cocaine|alcohol|opioid|nicotine|amphetamine|cannabis|tobacco|heroin|stimulant use|drug abuse|drug dependence|addict|gambling disorder|ethanol
disorders.notes: Mixed architecture: Mendelian (ALDH2, ADH1B, OPRM1) plus GWAS.

disorders.name: Bipolar
disorders.label: bipolar_and_related_disorders
disorders.disease_terms_regex: bipolar|cyclothymic|manic|hypomanic|mania|manic[- ]depressive|rapid cycling
disorders.notes: Key MDD contrast disorder (mood family, separate chapter since DSM-5). Mouse models centered on lithium responsiveness, mania-like hyperactivity, circadian rhythm disruption.

disorders.name: Anxiety
disorders.label: anxiety_disorders
disorders.disease_terms_regex: \banxiety\b|generalized anxiety|\bgad\b|panic disorder|panic attack|social anxiety|specific phobia|\bphobi|agoraphobia|separation anxiety|selective mutism|anxious
disorders.notes: MDD contrast disorder (high comorbidity but distinct neurobiology). Mouse models: EPM, open field, light-dark box, stress-induced hyperthermia.

disorders.name: PTSD
disorders.label: post_traumatic_stress_disorder

disorders.notes: Split from anxiety in DSM-5 (HPA-axis/fear-circuit divergence). Mouse models: fear conditioning + extinction failure, predator stress, footshock, chronic restraint stress.

disease_terms_regex_2026_05_24.before: post[- ]traumatic stress|\bptsd\b|acute stress disorder|adjustment disorder|reactive attachment|disinhibited social engagement|prolonged grief
disease_terms_regex_2026_05_24.after: post[- ]?traumatic stress|\bptsd\b|acute stress disorder|adjustment disorder|reactive attachment|disinhibited social engagement|prolonged grief|traumatic stress

chapter7_completion_2026_05_24.regex_added: complicated grief, persistent complex bereavement, adjustment reaction (PTSD chapter 7 now fully covers chapter scope)

disorders.name: OCD
disorders.label: obsessive_compulsive_and_related
disorders.disease_terms_regex: obsessive[- ]?compulsive|\bocd\b|body dysmorphic|hoarding|trichotillomania|excoriation|skin[- ]picking
disorders.notes: Split from anxiety in DSM-5 (CSTC-loop neurobiology). Mouse models: compulsive grooming, marble burying, stereotypy, perseveration.

disorders.name: ADHD
disorders.label: attention_deficit_hyperactivity_disorder
disorders.disease_terms_regex: attention[- ]?deficit|\badhd\b|attention deficit hyperactivity|hyperkinetic disorder
disorders.notes: NDD chapter, sibling to ASD. Mouse models: hyperactivity, impulsivity (5-CSRTT), attention failure, MPH-responsive locomotion.

disorders.name: IntellectualDisability
disorders.label: intellectual_disability

disorders.notes: NDD chapter sibling. Often comorbid with ASD. Mouse models: Morris water maze, novel object recognition, contextual fear conditioning, working memory.

disease_terms_regex_2026_05_24.after: intellectual disability|mental retardation|fragile x|rett syndrome|cognitive disability|cognitive impairment|down syndrome|williams syndrome|prader[- ]willi|angelman

doid_false_positive_removed_2026_05_24.reason: impulse control disorder belongs in Chapter 14 (DisruptiveImpulseControl), not NDD/IntellectualDisability

rescue_build.source_schema: v3_t1d binary masks (generated by build_id_tier_masks.py; no prior v3_t1d/ID_* existed) -> build_rescuepools_from_v3t1d.py (PM flag 6).
rescue_build.etiology_route: T1d-primary (DDG2P-confirmed; DDD). GWAS coverage partial; T1g not in headline.
rescue_build.config_naming_note: Prompt referenced id.disorder.json + a taxonomy_columns block; neither exists. Real configs: intellectualdisability_2dom.disorder.json (2-domain canonical per Tier-0 close-out) and intellectualdisability.disorder.json (3-domain). Check 2 adapted to a recursive ASD-leak walk; both configs PASS.

preflight_asd_contamination.check1_taxonomy_id_keyed: PASS (156 strict / 3 domains; 0 strict at tier-5)
preflight_asd_contamination.check2_config_refs_id_keyed: PASS-adapted (no asd_v3 refs in either ID config; no taxonomy_columns block exists)
preflight_asd_contamination.check5_cross_disorder_comparator_doc: DOC (A5 ID-vs-ASD must use --id_taxonomy + --asd_taxonomy as two independent inputs)
preflight_asd_contamination.check6_spotcheck: PASS-adapted (sampled T1d positives carry a DDG2P-confirmed gene; ID-strict, not ASD-strict)

T1d_consortium.note: 934 is broader than Kaplanis 2020's empirical 285 because PanelApp Green-confirmed dominant has expanded via continued curation since 2020. Recall-oriented operational state. Historical Kaplanis-285 = one-line intersect with Kaplanis 2020 Supp S1 if a reviewer asks (not a re-run).

T1d_provisional.source: publishedDeNovos ID subset (1,332 DNVs, >=2-DNV cutoff) -> denovo_db_id_genes.tsv (NOT YET EXTRACTED)
T1d_provisional.reason: PM flag 4: extract in parallel; do NOT block ID evaluation. DDG2P-only T1d_strict is publishable now. Once extracted, append to t1d_catalog.json (in_t1d_strict_provisional:true) and rebuild.

T1g_sensitivity.reason: PM flag 5: Savage 2018 is a cognitive-ability GWAS, not an ID GWAS; cross-trait proxy excluded from headline (etiology route = T1d). Supplementary-only under a separate report.

depth_mpclass.interpretation: Same canonical pattern as ASD/SCZ/MDD: DDG2P rescue additions collapse toward the broad_other floor (behavioral 0.099 vs 0.077). ID T0 behavioral_frac (0.431) is lower than ASD 0.675 / SCZ 0.563 -- consistent with ID's mouse signal being cognitive/learning rather than socially saturated (Tier-0 close-out).

tier0_baseline_for_downstream.A5_ID_vs_ASD: 0.228 (Δ-0.20, p=0.0007) strong inversion -- ASD mice score higher on ID criteria (shared cognitive axis + gene overlap).
tier0_baseline_for_downstream.note: ID Tier 0 already beats Phenodigm on A2; rescue tests whether the DDG2P-defined positive pool sustains the headline at higher n.

disorders.notes: Exploratory comparator. Mouse models: food intake regulation, sucrose preference, activity-based anorexia, binge-eating paradigms.

disorders.name: Neurocognitive
disorders.label: neurocognitive_disorders

disorders.notes: Boundary test: more neurological than psychiatric. Useful for testing whether the psychiatric benchmark dissociates from progressive neurodegeneration. Mouse models: age-dependent cognitive decline, plaque/tangle pathology, motor decline.

disorders.name: Sleep
disorders.label: sleep_wake_disorders
disorders.disease_terms_regex: insomnia disorder|hypersomnolence|narcolepsy|cataplexy|breathing[- ]related sleep|circadian rhythm sleep|parasomnia|restless leg|nightmare disorder|rem sleep behavior|sleep[- ]wake|sleep disorder
disorders.notes: Adjacent to MDD (insomnia/hypersomnia in Criterion A) and Bipolar (circadian disruption mechanism). Required for differential-diagnosis specificity testing.

disorders.name: Dissociative
disorders.label: dissociative_disorders
disorders.disease_terms_regex: dissociative identity|dissociative amnesia|depersonalization|derealization|dissociative disorder
disorders.notes: Chapter 8 included for DSM-5 comprehensiveness; mouse model coverage is essentially nil. Expect Tier 1 n near zero. Inclusion prevents broad_other contamination.

disorders.name: Somatic
disorders.label: somatic_symptom_and_related_disorders
disorders.disease_terms_regex: somatic symptom|illness anxiety|conversion disorder|factitious|hypochondriasis|munchausen
disorders.notes: Chapter 9 included for completeness; mouse construct validity is questionable. Chronic-pain and sickness-behavior paradigms are the closest behavioral analogues.

disorders.name: Elimination
disorders.label: elimination_disorders
disorders.disease_terms_regex: enuresis|encopresis|elimination disorder|urinary incontinence|fecal incontinence
disorders.notes: Chapter 11. Mouse voiding-behavior phenotyping exists but rarely tagged as psychiatric; included for coverage symmetry.

disorders.name: SexualGender
disorders.label: sexual_dysfunctions_and_gender_dysphoria
disorders.disease_terms_regex: sexual dysfunction|erectile dysfunction|hypoactive sexual desire|female sexual arousal|gender dysphoria|gender identity disorder|delayed ejaculation|orgasmic disorder
disorders.notes: Chapter 13. Mouse copulatory/mating behavior phenotyping exists. Gender dysphoria has no animal analogue; covered nominally.

disorders.name: DisruptiveImpulseControl
disorders.label: disruptive_impulse-control_and_conduct_disorders
disorders.disease_terms_regex: oppositional defiant|conduct disorder|intermittent explosive|antisocial personality|pyromania|kleptomania|impulse control disorder
disorders.notes: Chapter 14. Note: DOID:10937 (impulse control disorder) belongs here, NOT in IntellectualDisability (M3 pitfall fix).

disorders.name: PersonalityDisorders
disorders.label: personality_disorders_(clusters_a_b_c)
disorders.disease_terms_regex: personality disorder|borderline personality|narcissistic personality|histrionic personality|avoidant personality|dependent personality|paranoid personality|schizoid personality|obsessive[- ]compulsive personality|antisocial personality
disorders.notes: Chapter 17. Borderline (cluster B) flagged in user's MDD differential as high-stakes confound. Mouse models are limited but components are tractable.

disorders.name: Paraphilic
disorders.label: paraphilic_disorders
disorders.disease_terms_regex: paraphilia|paraphilic|sexual deviance|fetishism|pedophilia|exhibitionism
disorders.notes: Chapter 18. Expect Tier 1 n ≈ 0; included only to prevent broad_other contamination by any paraphilia-tagged DOID.

candidate_gene_seeding.comment: Seeding determines which genes are sent to DisGeNET. Inclusion is gated by DisGeNET source classification, not seeding.
